.hero-image-container {

  position: relative;
  max-width: 1260px;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto;
  top: -100px;
  margin-bottom: calc(-270px - 4vw);
  @media screen and (max-width: 860px) {

    top: -30px;
    margin-bottom: calc(-130px - 11vw);
  
}

}

.hero-image {
  width: 100%;
  /* These shenanigans are to account for centering the image based on the center of the dashboard, not including the two things on the sides */
  /* First calculate the extensions based on the container width */
  --right-extension: calc(100% / 6.74);
  --left-extension: calc(100% / 7.88);
  /* Then calculate the offset needed to center */
  --offset: calc((var(--right-extension) - var(--left-extension)) / 2);
  /* Apply the offset */
  transform: translateX(var(--offset));
}

/* Jun 2025 homepage update styles */
/*
  Overview Layout is only used on homepage for now
  using that as wrapper class to do some special styling just for homepage
*/

/*}*/
#fern-sidebar {

  overflow: hidden;
  width: 100%;

.button-group {

  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  @media screen and (min-width: 768px) {

    flex-direction: row;
  
}

}

.button {

  display: inline-flex;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 60px;
  padding: 16px 38px;
  color: #ffffff;
  background: linear-gradient(179deg, #405bff 1.06%, #7084ff 123.42%);
  transition: filter 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease, border 0.3s ease;
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 16px;
  text-decoration: none;
  justify-content: center;

  svg {
    display: none;
  }

}

.button:hover {
  filter: brightness(0.8);
  text-decoration: none;
}
.button:focus-visible {
  filter: brightness(0.8);
  text-decoration: none; outline: none;
}

.button.alt {
  border-radius: 60px;
  color: #405BFF;
  background: transparent;
  border: solid 1px #405BFF;
}

.dark .button.alt {
  color: #7084FF;
  border: solid 1px #7084FF;
}

.button.alt:hover {
  border-color: #7084ff;
  color: #7084ff;
  filter: brightness(1);
}
.button.alt:focus-visible {
  border-color: #7084ff;
  color: #7084ff;
  filter: brightness(1); outline: none;
}

.dark .button.alt:hover {
  border-color: #7084ff;
  color: #7084ff;
  filter: brightness(1.2);
}
.dark .button.alt:focus-visible {
  border-color: #7084ff;
  color: #7084ff;
  filter: brightness(1.2); outline: none;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 768px) {

  .button {
    padding: 14px 32px;
  }

  .button.alt {
    padding: 14px 32px;
  }

}

}
.dark .fern-header-search-bar {
  --tw-ring-color: #7084FF !important;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #7084FF inset !important;
}

    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  
}

}

.docs-home .homepage-grid-card {

  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 22px 18px;
  text-decoration: none;
  position: relative;
  transition: filter 0.3s ease;
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 1/1;
  @media screen and (min-width: 1300px) {

    width: 190px;
    height: 195px;
  
}

}

.docs-home .homepage-grid-card:hover {
  filter: brightness(1.4);
}
.docs-home .homepage-grid-card:focus-visible {
  filter: brightness(1.4); outline: none;
}

.docs-home .homepage-grid-card img {
  position: absolute;
  top: -1px;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  z-index: 0;
}

.docs-home .homepage-grid-card span {
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.2;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: #ffffff;
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}

/* ── Hero redesign ──────────────────────────────────── */

/* Light mode: hero text goes dark */
.light .docs-home .darker {
  color: #000;
}
.light .docs-home .darker .home-hero-body * {
  color: #58595B;
}

/* h1: larger, bolder */
.docs-home .heading-container h1 {
  font-size: 52px;
  line-height: 1.1;
  margin: 0 0 20px;
}
.light .docs-home .heading-container h1 {
  color: #000;
}

/* Eyebrow chip — bordered pill */
.docs-home .heading-container .eyebrow-chip {
  display: inline-block;
  border: 1.5px solid currentColor;
  border-radius: 100px;
  padding: 5px 14px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin: 0 0 20px;
}
.light .docs-home .heading-container .eyebrow-chip {
  color: #000;
}
.dark .docs-home .heading-container .eyebrow-chip {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
}

/* Hero decoration (right side, behind cards) */
.docs-home .hero-chevron {

  display: none;
  position: absolute;
  inset: -40px calc(50% - 50vw) -40px 0;
  background: url("./images/homepage/Docs-Hero.svg") no-repeat right 120px center / auto 110%;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  @media screen and (min-width: 1170px) {

    display: block;
  
}

}
.dark .docs-home .hero-chevron {
  opacity: 0.5;
}

/* Lightning bolt overlay on top of hero background */
.docs-home .hero-chevron::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: #CFFC55;
  -webkit-mask-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 560.317 560.316' fill='white'%3E%3Cpath d='M207.523,560.316c0,0,194.42-421.925,194.444-421.986l10.79-23.997c-41.824,12.02-135.271,34.902-135.57,35.833C286.96,122.816,329.017,0,330.829,0c-39.976,0-79.952,0-119.927,0l-12.167,57.938l-51.176,209.995l135.191-36.806L207.523,560.316z'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
  -webkit-mask-repeat: no-repeat;
  -webkit-mask-position: calc(100% - 120px) center;
  -webkit-mask-size: auto 110%;
  mask-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 560.317 560.316' fill='white'%3E%3Cpath d='M207.523,560.316c0,0,194.42-421.925,194.444-421.986l10.79-23.997c-41.824,12.02-135.271,34.902-135.57,35.833C286.96,122.816,329.017,0,330.829,0c-39.976,0-79.952,0-119.927,0l-12.167,57.938l-51.176,209.995l135.191-36.806L207.523,560.316z'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
  mask-repeat: no-repeat;
  mask-position: calc(100% - 120px) center;
  mask-size: auto 110%;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.dark .docs-home .hero-chevron::after {
  background: rgba(207, 252, 85, 0.7);
}

/* Subtle grid background for hero */
.docs-home .darker {
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(to right, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 64px 64px;
  background-position: center top;
}
.dark .docs-home .darker {
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(to right, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px);
}

/* Lift hero content above the chevron */
.docs-home .hero-container {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

/* Primary button: yellow-green in both modes (scoped to docs-home) */
.docs-home .button {
  background: #CFFC55;
  color: #000;
  border: 1px solid #000;
}
.docs-home .button:hover {
  filter: brightness(0.9);
}
.docs-home .button:focus-visible {
  filter: brightness(0.9); outline: none;
}

/* Outlined button: dark in both modes (scoped to docs-home) */
.docs-home .button.alt {
  color: #000;
  border: 1px solid #1a1a1a;
  background: #ffffff;
}
.docs-home .button.alt:hover {
  color: #000;
  border-color: #000;
  filter: brightness(1);
}
.docs-home .button.alt:focus-visible {
  color: #000;
  border-color: #000;
  filter: brightness(1); outline: none;
}

/* Custom mid page banner */
.docs-home-custom-banner-link {
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: filter 0.3s ease;
  display: block;
}

.docs-home-custom-banner-link:hover {
  filter: brightness(1.05);
}
.docs-home-custom-banner-link:focus-visible {
  filter: brightness(1.05); outline: none;
}

.light .docs-home-custom-banner-link:hover {
  filter: brightness(1.02);
}
.light .docs-home-custom-banner-link:focus-visible {
  filter: brightness(1.02); outline: none;
}

.docs-home-custom-banner {
  background: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: 1px solid #000;
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: 72px;
  padding: 16px;
  gap: 32px;
}

.dark .docs-home-custom-banner {
  background: #181a1f;
  border-color: #58595B;
  transition: border-color 0.3s ease;
}

.dark .docs-home-custom-banner-link:hover .docs-home-custom-banner {
  border-color: #CFFC55;
}
.dark .docs-home-custom-banner-link:focus-within .docs-home-custom-banner {
  border-color: #CFFC55; outline: none;
}

/* Sidebar scrollbar (dark mode: green to match accent) */
.dark #fern-sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,
.dark #fern-sidebar *::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background-color: #CFFC55;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.dark #fern-sidebar,
.dark #fern-sidebar * {
  scrollbar-color: #CFFC55 transparent;
}

.docs-home-custom-banner-graphic {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 180px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.docs-home-custom-banner-graphic img {
  margin: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}

.docs-home-custom-banner-content {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 8px 16px 8px 0;
}

.docs-home-custom-banner h5 {
  color: #1a1a1a;
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  font-family: Sohne;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.dark .docs-home-custom-banner h5 {
  color: #ffffff;
}

.docs-home-custom-banner p {
  color: #58595B;
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.dark .docs-home-custom-banner p {
  color: #D1D3D4;
}

@media screen and (max-width: 640px) {

  .docs-home-custom-banner {
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 16px;
  }
  .docs-home-custom-banner-graphic {
    width: 100%;
    height: 140px;
  }
  .docs-home-custom-banner-content {
    padding: 0 8px 8px;
  }

}


/* Home Start here section */
.docs-home .custom-cards {
  margin: 0 0 56px;
  padding: 0;
}

.docs-home .custom-cards h4 {
  font-size: 24px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.docs-home .docs-home-content .custom-cards a.fern-card {
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid #BCBEC0;
  box-shadow: none;
  transition: border 0.3s ease;
}

.dark .docs-home-content .custom-cards a.fern-card {
  background: transparent;
}

.docs-home .docs-home-content .custom-cards a.fern-card:not(:hover) {
  border: 1px solid #BCBEC0;
}
.dark .docs-home .docs-home-content .custom-cards a.fern-card:not(:hover) {
  border: 1px solid #58595B;
}
.docs-home .docs-home-content .custom-cards a.fern-card:hover {
  border-color: #CFFC55;
}
.docs-home .docs-home-content .custom-cards a.fern-card:focus-visible {
  border-color: #CFFC55; outline: none;
}

.docs-home .fern-card .card-icon {
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  padding: 6px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  width: 32px !important;
  height: 32px !important;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.docs-home .fern-card .card-icon svg {
  width: 18px !important;
  height: 18px !important;
}

/* Per-card icon background colors */
.docs-home .custom-cards a.fern-card:nth-child(1) .card-icon {
  background: #CFFC55;
}
.docs-home .custom-cards a.fern-card:nth-child(1) .card-icon svg,
.docs-home .custom-cards a.fern-card:nth-child(1) .card-icon svg path {
  fill: #1a1a1a;
}
.docs-home .custom-cards a.fern-card:nth-child(2) .card-icon {
  background: #C084FC;
}
.docs-home .custom-cards a.fern-card:nth-child(2) .card-icon svg,
.docs-home .custom-cards a.fern-card:nth-child(2) .card-icon svg path {
  fill: #ffffff;
}
.docs-home .custom-cards a.fern-card:nth-child(3) .card-icon {
  background: #38BDF8;
}
.docs-home .custom-cards a.fern-card:nth-child(3) .card-icon svg,
.docs-home .custom-cards a.fern-card:nth-child(3) .card-icon svg path {
  fill: #ffffff;
}

.docs-home .docs-home-content .fern-card .text-body {
  color: #58595B;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.dark .docs-home .docs-home-content .fern-card .text-body {
  color: #ffffff;
}

.docs-home .docs-home-content .custom-cards .fern-card p {
  color: #6D6E71;
  font-size: 16px;
}

.dark .docs-home-content .custom-cards .fern-card p {
  color: #ffffffaf;
}

.docs-home .fern-card svg,
.docs-home .fern-card svg path {
  fill: #58595B;
  transition: fill 0.3s ease;
}

.dark .docs-home .fern-card svg,
.dark .docs-home .fern-card svg path {
  fill: #F8F8F8;
}

.docs-home .fern-card:hover svg,
.docs-home .fern-card:hover svg path {
  fill: #CFFC55;
}
.docs-home .fern-card:focus-within svg,
.docs-home .fern-card:focus-within svg path {
  fill: #CFFC55; outline: none;
}

/* New notes styling */
.note-wrapper {
  margin-bottom: 56px;
}

.note-wrapper svg,
.note-wrapper svg path {
  fill: #405BFF;
  color: #405BFF
}

.note-wrapper h6 {
  font-family: Sohne;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #000;
}

.note-wrapper p {
  color: #58595B;
  font-size: 16px;
}

.dark .note-wrapper .fern-callout .leading-snug,
.dark .note-wrapper .fern-callout h6,
.dark .note-wrapper .fern-callout p {
  color: #ffffff;
}

.dark body#fern-docs .fern-callout[data-intent="note"] .fern-mdx-link:not(.button),
.dark body#fern-docs .fern-callout[data-intent="note"] .fern-mdx-link:not(.button) svg,
.dark body#fern-docs .fern-callout[data-intent="note"] .fern-mdx-link:not(.button) svg path {
  color: #9ac2ff !important;
}
.dark body#fern-docs .fern-callout[data-intent="note"] .fern-mdx-link:not(.button) code {
  color: #9ac2ff !important;
}
.dark body#fern-docs .fern-callout[data-intent="note"] code {
  color: #9ac2ff !important;
}

.dark body#fern-docs .fern-callout[data-intent="error"] .fern-mdx-link:not(.button),
.dark body#fern-docs .fern-callout[data-intent="error"] .fern-mdx-link:not(.button) svg,
.dark body#fern-docs .fern-callout[data-intent="error"] .fern-mdx-link:not(.button) svg path {
  color: #ff8282 !important;
}
.dark body#fern-docs .fern-callout[data-intent="error"] .fern-mdx-link:not(.button) code {
  color: #ff8282 !important;
}
.dark body#fern-docs .fern-callout[data-intent="error"] code {
  color: #ff8282 !important;
}

.dark body#fern-docs .fern-callout[data-intent="warning"] .fern-mdx-link:not(.button),
.dark body#fern-docs .fern-callout[data-intent="warning"] .fern-mdx-link:not(.button) svg,
.dark body#fern-docs .fern-callout[data-intent="warning"] .fern-mdx-link:not(.button) svg path {
  color: #ffd342 !important;
}
.dark body#fern-docs .fern-callout[data-intent="warning"] .fern-mdx-link:not(.button) code {
  color: #ffd342 !important;
}
.dark body#fern-docs .fern-callout[data-intent="warning"] code {
  color: #ffd342 !important;
}

/* What's new table */
.homepage-whats-new .homepage-whats-new-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  width: 100%;
  margin-bottom: 40px;
}

.homepage-whats-new .homepage-whats-new-header h4 {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 24px;
}

.homepage-whats-new .see-all-updates {
  text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-block;
  margin-top: 24px;
}

.homepage-whats-new .see-all-updates:hover svg {
  transform: translateX(8px);
}
.homepage-whats-new .see-all-updates:focus-within svg {
  transform: translateX(8px); outline: none;
}

.homepage-whats-new .see-all-updates svg {
  position: relative;
  left: 4px;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.homepage-whats-new .see-all-updates svg,
.homepage-whats-new .see-all-updates svg path {
  fill: #CFFC55;
}

.fern-table-root,
.fern-table-root .fern-table {
  border: none;
}

.fern-table-root .fern-table tr td {
  padding: 16px 8px;
}

.fern-table-root .fern-table tr td:first-child {

  @media screen and (min-width: 860px) {

    width: 140px;
  
}

}

.docs-home .whats-new-table tr:nth-child(n+8) {
  display: none;
}



/* more info section */
section.more-info {
  max-width: 100%;
  padding: 0;
}

section.more-info .sdk-grid {

  @media screen and (max-width: 860px) {

    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  
}

}

.docs-home .more-info .sdk-item img {
  margin: 0;
}

.docs-home .more-info .sdk-item p {
  margin: auto 0;
  line-height: 1;
}

div.resource-grid {

  margin-bottom: 0;
  @media screen and (min-width: 768px) {

    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  
}

}

div.resource-grid .resource-item img {
  margin: 0 auto;
}

/* Inner page helpers */
.number-monospace {
  width: 24px;
  display: inline-block;
}
.text-indent {
  padding-left: 28px;
}

/* Light mode: keep inline content links blue (accent-primary is lime for nav/tabs) */
:is(.light) body#fern-docs .fern-mdx-link:not(.button) {
  color: #405BFF;
}
:is(.light) body#fern-docs .fern-mdx-link:not(.button):hover {
  color: #7084FF;
}
:is(.light) body#fern-docs .fern-mdx-link:not(.button):focus-visible {
  color: #7084FF; outline: none;
}
/* Shared styles for action buttons (Cursor + Read Me) */

/* CSS Variables */
:root {
  --setup-icon-size: 1rem;
  --setup-toast-icon-size: 1.25rem;
  --setup-button-height: 2rem;
  --setup-spacing-xs: 0.25rem;
  --setup-spacing-sm: 0.375rem;
  --setup-spacing-md: 0.5rem;
  --setup-spacing-lg: 0.625rem;
  --setup-spacing-xl: 0.75rem;
  --setup-spacing-2xl: 0.875rem;
  --setup-border-radius: 0.5rem;
  --setup-font-size: 0.875rem;
  --setup-toast-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.light {
  --setup-bg-primary: #fff;
  --setup-bg-secondary: #191919;
  --setup-text-primary: #1c273a;
  --setup-text-secondary: #fff;
  --setup-border-primary: #d8dde3;
  --setup-border-hover: #9ca0a7;
  --setup-border-secondary: #ffffff22;
  --setup-shadow: 0 0.5rem 1.5rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}

.dark {
  --setup-bg-primary: #191919;
  --setup-bg-secondary: #fff;
  --setup-bg-hover: #ffffff12;
  --setup-text-primary: #fff;
  --setup-text-secondary: #1c273a;
  --setup-border-primary: #ffffff22;
  --setup-border-hover: #ffffff22;
  --setup-border-secondary: #d8dde3;
  --setup-shadow: 0 0.5rem 1.5rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}

.action-icon {
  position: relative;
  width: var(--setup-icon-size);
  height: var(--setup-icon-size);
  display: inline-block;
}

.action-icon svg {
  display: block;
  width: var(--setup-icon-size);
  height: var(--setup-icon-size);
}

.light .icon-dark {
  display: none;
}

.dark .icon-light {
  display: none;
}

.action-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--setup-spacing-sm);
  padding-block: var(--setup-spacing-xs);
  padding-inline: var(--setup-spacing-xl);
  border-radius: var(--setup-border-radius);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: var(--setup-font-size);
  height: var(--setup-button-height);
  text-decoration: none;
  background-color: var(--setup-bg-primary);
  border: 1px solid var(--setup-border-primary);
  color: var(--setup-text-primary);
}

.action-button:hover {
  border-color: var(--setup-border-hover);
}
.action-button:focus-visible {
  border-color: var(--setup-border-hover); outline: none;
}

.dark .action-button:hover {
  background-color: var(--setup-bg-hover);
}
.dark .action-button:focus-visible {
  background-color: var(--setup-bg-hover); outline: none;
}

.action-toast {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--setup-spacing-md);
  position: fixed;
  bottom: var(--setup-toast-bottom);
  padding: var(--setup-spacing-lg) var(--setup-spacing-2xl);
  border-radius: var(--setup-border-radius);
  z-index: 1;
  background: var(--setup-bg-primary);
  color: var(--setup-text-primary);
  border: 1px solid var(--setup-border-primary);
  box-shadow: var(--setup-shadow);
}

.action-toast-icon svg {
  width: var(--setup-toast-icon-size);
  height: var(--setup-toast-icon-size);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.action-toast-icon path {
  fill: var(--setup-text-primary);
}


/* Tutorial Grid Styles */
.tutorial-grid-container {
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
}

.tutorial-filter-tabs {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  padding-bottom: 1rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--setup-border-primary);
}

.tutorial-filter-tab {
  padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
  border-radius: 2rem;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--setup-text-primary);
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.tutorial-filter-tab:hover {
  background: var(--setup-bg-hover, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05));
}
.tutorial-filter-tab:focus-visible {
  background: var(--setup-bg-hover, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)); outline: none;
}

.tutorial-filter-tab.active {
  background: #405BFF;
  color: #fff;
  border-color: #405BFF;
}

.tutorial-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr));
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

.tutorial-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 1.25rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--setup-border-primary);
  border-radius: 0.75rem;
  background: var(--setup-bg-primary);
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--setup-text-primary);
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.tutorial-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--setup-border-hover);
  box-shadow: var(--setup-shadow);
}
.tutorial-card:focus-visible {
  border-color: var(--setup-border-hover);
  box-shadow: var(--setup-shadow); outline: none;
}

.tutorial-card-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.tutorial-category-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.025em;
  background: rgba(64, 91, 255, 0.1);
  color: #405BFF;
  border-radius: 0.25rem;
}

.tutorial-date {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: #6b7280;
}

.tutorial-card-title {
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.4;
  margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0;
}

.tutorial-card-description {
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  color: #6b7280;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin: 0 0 1rem 0;
  flex-grow: 1;
}

.tutorial-card-author {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  color: var(--setup-text-primary);
}

.tutorial-author-icon {
  font-size: 1rem;
}

.tutorial-empty {
  text-align: center;
  color: #6b7280;
  padding: 2rem;
}

Append /llms.txt to any URL for a page-level index, or .md for the markdown version of any page.</div><style>
:root {
  --bprogress-color: var(--accent);
  --bprogress-height: 3px;
  --bprogress-spinner-size: 18px;
  --bprogress-spinner-animation-duration: 400ms;
  --bprogress-spinner-border-size: 2px;
  --bprogress-box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent), 0 0 5px var(--accent);
  --bprogress-z-index: 99999;
  --bprogress-spinner-top: 15px;
  --bprogress-spinner-bottom: auto;
  --bprogress-spinner-right: 15px;
  --bprogress-spinner-left: auto;
}

.bprogress {
  width: 0;
  height: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: var(--bprogress-z-index);
}

.bprogress .bar {
  background: var(--bprogress-color);
  position: fixed;
  z-index: var(--bprogress-z-index);
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: var(--bprogress-height);
}

/* Fancy blur effect */
.bprogress .peg {
  display: block;
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  width: 100px;
  height: 100%;
  box-shadow: var(--bprogress-box-shadow);
  opacity: 1.0;
  transform: rotate(3deg) translate(0px, -4px);
}

/* Remove these to get rid of the spinner */
.bprogress .spinner {
  display: block;
  position: fixed;
  z-index: var(--bprogress-z-index);
  top: var(--bprogress-spinner-top);
  bottom: var(--bprogress-spinner-bottom);
  right: var(--bprogress-spinner-right);
  left: var(--bprogress-spinner-left);
}

.bprogress .spinner-icon {
  width: var(--bprogress-spinner-size);
  height: var(--bprogress-spinner-size);
  box-sizing: border-box;
  border: solid var(--bprogress-spinner-border-size) transparent;
  border-top-color: var(--bprogress-color);
  border-left-color: var(--bprogress-color);
  border-radius: 50%;
  -webkit-animation: bprogress-spinner var(--bprogress-spinner-animation-duration) linear infinite;
  animation: bprogress-spinner var(--bprogress-spinner-animation-duration) linear infinite;
}

.bprogress-custom-parent {
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
}

.bprogress-custom-parent .bprogress .spinner,
.bprogress-custom-parent .bprogress .bar {
  position: absolute;
}

.bprogress .indeterminate {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: var(--bprogress-height);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.bprogress .indeterminate .inc,
.bprogress .indeterminate .dec {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  height: 100%;
  background-color: var(--bprogress-color);
}

.bprogress .indeterminate .inc {
  animation: bprogress-indeterminate-increase 2s infinite;
}

.bprogress .indeterminate .dec {
  animation: bprogress-indeterminate-decrease 2s 0.5s infinite;
}

@-webkit-keyframes bprogress-spinner {
  0%   { -webkit-transform: rotate(0deg); transform: rotate(0deg); }
  100% { -webkit-transform: rotate(360deg); transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

@keyframes bprogress-spinner {
  0%   { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }
}

@keyframes bprogress-indeterminate-increase {
  from { left: -5%; width: 5%; }
  to { left: 130%; width: 100%; }
}

@keyframes bprogress-indeterminate-decrease {
  from { left: -80%; width: 80%; }
  to { left: 110%; width: 10%; }
}

<h2 id="get-started" data-state="closed" style="cursor:pointer">Get started</h2>
<p>LaunchDarkly AI SDKs interact with <a class="fern-mdx-link" href="/docs/home/getting-started/vocabulary#agentcontrol-config">AgentControl configs</a>. Configs are the LaunchDarkly resources that manage model configurations and messages for your generative AI applications.</p>
<div data-intent="tip" class="fern-callout"><div class="flex items-start space-x-4"><div class="[&amp;_svg]:size-icon-md mt-0.5 w-4"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-star"><path d="M11.525 2.295a.53.53 0 0 1 .95 0l2.31 4.679a2.123 2.123 0 0 0 1.595 1.16l5.166.756a.53.53 0 0 1 .294.904l-3.736 3.638a2.123 2.123 0 0 0-.611 1.878l.882 5.14a.53.53 0 0 1-.771.56l-4.618-2.428a2.122 2.122 0 0 0-1.973 0L6.396 21.01a.53.53 0 0 1-.77-.56l.881-5.139a2.122 2.122 0 0 0-.611-1.879L2.16 9.795a.53.53 0 0 1 .294-.906l5.165-.755a2.122 2.122 0 0 0 1.597-1.16z"></path></svg></div><div class="-my-4 flex-1 overflow-x-auto text-sm before:mb-4 before:block after:mt-4 after:block"><h5 class="leading-snug">Try the Quickstart</h5><p>This reference guide describes working specifically with the Python AI SDK. For a complete introduction to LaunchDarkly AI SDKs and how they interact with configs, read <a class="fern-mdx-link" href="/docs/home/agentcontrol/quickstart">Quickstart for AgentControl</a>.</p></div></div></div>
<p>You can use the Python AI SDK to customize your config based on the <a class="fern-mdx-link" href="/docs/home/getting-started/vocabulary#context">context</a> that you provide. This means both the messages and the model evaluation in your generative AI application are specific to each end user, at runtime. You can also use the AI SDKs to record metrics from your AI model generation, including duration and tokens.</p>
<p>Follow these instructions to start using the Python AI SDK in your Python application.</p>
<h3 id="understand-version-compatibility" data-state="closed" style="cursor:pointer">Understand version compatibility</h3>
<p>The LaunchDarkly Python AI SDK is compatible with Python 3.8.0 and higher.</p>
<h3 id="install-the-sdk" data-state="closed" style="cursor:pointer">Install the SDK</h3>
<p>First, install the AI SDK as a dependency in your application using your application’s dependency manager. If you want to depend on a specific version, refer to the <a class="fern-mdx-link" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" href="https://github.com/launchdarkly/python-server-sdk-ai/releases">SDK releases page<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-external-link external-link-icon"><path d="M15 3h6v6"></path><path d="M10 14 21 3"></path><path d="M18 13v6a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V8a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h6"></path></svg></a> to identify the latest version.</p>

<h3 id="customize-a-config" data-state="closed" style="cursor:pointer">Customize a config</h3>
<p>Customize your config to set values for variables used in messages or instructions based on the context attributes and variables you provide.</p>
<p>The details of customizing a config depend on whether you are using configs in completion mode or agent mode. You set the mode for a particular config when you <a class="fern-mdx-link" href="/docs/home/agentcontrol/create">create it</a> in the LaunchDarkly UI.</p>
<h4 id="customize-configs-in-completion-mode" data-state="closed" style="cursor:pointer">Customize configs in completion mode</h4>
<p>In completion mode, each variation in your config includes a single set of roles and messages used to prompt your generative AI model.</p>
<p>In completion mode, use <code>completion_config()</code> to customize the config.</p>
<p>The <code>completion_config()</code> function takes an AgentControl config key, a context, a fallback value, and optional variables. It performs the evaluation, then returns an <code>AICompletionConfig</code> object that includes the customized messages and model configuration. Call <code>create_tracker()</code> on the returned object to get a tracker instance you can use to record metrics.</p>
<p>If it cannot perform the evaluation or LaunchDarkly is unreachable, the SDK returns the fallback configuration you provided. For example, you might use an empty, disabled <code>AICompletionConfigDefault</code> as a fallback value, or a fully configured default. Either way, check for this case and handle it appropriately in your application.</p>
<p>Here’s how:</p>

<h3 id="evaluate-input-and-output-pairs-with-a-judge" data-state="closed" style="cursor:pointer">Evaluate input and output pairs with a judge</h3>
<p>Use <code>create_judge()</code> when you need to score a specific input and output pair in application code. This is useful for external pipelines, custom orchestration, or any case where you want to evaluate output directly instead of attaching a judge to a completion-mode config variation.</p>
<p><code>create_judge()</code> retrieves the judge configuration for the provided context. Then, call <code>evaluate()</code> on the returned judge to score the input and output pair.</p>
<p>Here’s how:</p>

<p>In this example:</p>
<ul class="[&amp;&gt;li]:relative [&amp;&gt;li]:before:text-(color:--grayscale-a10) mb-3 list-none pl-3 [&amp;&gt;li]:pl-3 [&amp;&gt;li]:before:absolute [&amp;&gt;li]:before:ml-[-22px] [&amp;&gt;li]:before:mt-[-1px] [&amp;&gt;li]:before:content-[&#x27;⦁&#x27;] [&amp;&gt;li]:before:self-center">
<li class=""><code>create_judge()</code> retrieves the judge configuration for the provided context</li>
<li class=""><code>evaluate()</code> scores the input and output pair</li>
<li class="">the returned result includes structured evaluation data</li>
</ul>
<p>If you want to record returned evaluation scores as metrics associated with a config, track those scores in your application code using the config’s <code>tracker</code>.</p>
<p>Programmatic judge evaluation does not automatically emit <strong class="font-semibold">Monitoring</strong> tab metrics. It also does not attach judges to variations in the LaunchDarkly UI.</p>
<p>To learn more, read <a class="fern-mdx-link" href="/docs/home/agentcontrol/online-evaluations">Online evaluations in AgentControl</a>.</p>
<h4 id="customize-configs-in-agent-mode" data-state="closed" style="cursor:pointer">Customize configs in agent mode</h4>
<p>In agent mode, each variation in your config includes a set of instructions that enable multi-step workflows.</p>
<p>In <code>agent</code> mode, use <code>agent_config()</code> or <code>agent_configs()</code> to customize the config. The <code>agent_config()</code> function customizes a single agent config, while the <code>agent_configs()</code> function customizes a list of them.</p>
<p>The instructions returned by the SDK come directly from the instructions you define for the variation in the LaunchDarkly UI. The goal or task shown in the UI is delivered unchanged as the <code>instructions</code> field in the SDK.</p>
<p>Both functions take an AgentControl config key, a context, a fallback value, and optional variables. They perform the evaluation, then return an <code>AIAgentConfig</code> object that includes the customized instructions. Call <code>create_tracker()</code> on the returned object to get a tracker instance for recording metrics.</p>
<p>If the function cannot perform the evaluation or LaunchDarkly is unreachable, it returns the fallback value.</p>
<p>For example, you might use an empty, disabled <code>AIAgentConfigDefault</code> as a fallback value, or a fully configured default. Either way, you should make sure to check for this case and handle it appropriately in your application.</p>
<p>Here’s how:</p>

<h3 id="call-the-provider-and-record-metrics-from-ai-model-generation" data-state="closed" style="cursor:pointer">Call the provider and record metrics from AI model generation</h3>
<p>Finally, make a request to your generative AI provider and record metrics from your AI model generation.</p>
<p>In completion mode, use the tracker’s <code>track_metrics_of()</code> method to call your generative AI provider and record metrics from model generation. Pass a metrics extractor function (such as <code>get_ai_metrics_from_response</code> from the provider-specific package) and the call you want to make. Check whether the returned <code>config</code> is enabled and handle the disabled case appropriately in your application.</p>
<p>If your AgentControl config uses <code>agent</code> mode, you can access the <code>instructions</code> returned from the customized AgentControl config to send to your AI model. Call <code>create_tracker()</code> on the returned <code>AIAgentConfig</code> object to get a tracker instance you can use to record metrics.</p>
<p>Tracking AI metrics does not automatically associate traces with the config.</p>
<div data-intent="important" class="fern-callout"><div class="flex items-start space-x-4"><div class="[&amp;_svg]:size-icon-md mt-0.5 w-4"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-info"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"></circle><path d="M12 16v-4"></path><path d="M12 8h.01"></path></svg></div><div class="-my-4 flex-1 overflow-x-auto text-sm before:mb-4 before:block after:mt-4 after:block"><h5 class="leading-snug">Run model calls inside an active span to associate traces</h5><p>LaunchDarkly can associate traces with an evaluated config only when the model request runs inside an active parent span.</p><p>If you use the LaunchDarkly Observability SDK, import <code>observe</code> from <code>ldobserve</code> and wrap each model request in <code>observe.start_span()</code>. This creates the parent span LaunchDarkly uses to link the LLM span to the evaluated config. LaunchDarkly cannot associate the trace with the config if the model call does not run inside an active span.</p><p>To learn more, read <a class="fern-mdx-link" href="/docs/home/observability/llm-observability">LLM observability</a> and <a class="fern-mdx-link" href="/docs/home/agentcontrol/monitor">Monitor configs</a>.</p></div></div></div>
<p>The following example shows how to wrap an OpenAI completion request in an active span so LaunchDarkly can associate traces with the evaluated config.</p>

<p>Alternatively, you can use the SDK’s other <code>track_*</code> functions to record these metrics manually. You may need to do this if your application requires streaming, since <code>track_metrics_of()</code> expects the wrapped call to return a complete response.</p>
<p>In <code>completion</code> mode, make sure to call <code>completion_config()</code> each time you generate content from your AI model:</p>

id=\"get-started\" data-state=\"closed\" style=\"cursor:pointer\"\u003eGet started\u003c/h2\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eLaunchDarkly AI SDKs interact with \u003ca class=\"fern-mdx-link\" href=\"/docs/home/getting-started/vocabulary#agentcontrol-config\"\u003eAgentControl configs\u003c/a\u003e. Configs are the LaunchDarkly resources that manage model configurations and messages for your generative AI applications.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv data-intent=\"tip\" class=\"fern-callout\"\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"flex items-start space-x-4\"\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"[\u0026amp;_svg]:size-icon-md mt-0.5 w-4\"\u003e\u003csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-star\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"M11.525 2.295a.53.53 0 0 1 .95 0l2.31 4.679a2.123 2.123 0 0 0 1.595 1.16l5.166.756a.53.53 0 0 1 .294.904l-3.736 3.638a2.123 2.123 0 0 0-.611 1.878l.882 5.14a.53.53 0 0 1-.771.56l-4.618-2.428a2.122 2.122 0 0 0-1.973 0L6.396 21.01a.53.53 0 0 1-.77-.56l.881-5.139a2.122 2.122 0 0 0-.611-1.879L2.16 9.795a.53.53 0 0 1 .294-.906l5.165-.755a2.122 2.122 0 0 0 1.597-1.16z\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"-my-4 flex-1 overflow-x-auto text-sm before:mb-4 before:block after:mt-4 after:block\"\u003e\u003ch5 class=\"leading-snug\"\u003eTry the Quickstart\u003c/h5\u003e\u003cp\u003eThis reference guide describes working specifically with the Python AI SDK. For a complete introduction to LaunchDarkly AI SDKs and how they interact with configs, read \u003ca class=\"fern-mdx-link\" href=\"/docs/home/agentcontrol/quickstart\"\u003eQuickstart for AgentControl\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eYou can use the Python AI SDK to customize your config based on the \u003ca class=\"fern-mdx-link\" href=\"/docs/home/getting-started/vocabulary#context\"\u003econtext\u003c/a\u003e that you provide. This means both the messages and the model evaluation in your generative AI application are specific to each end user, at runtime. You can also use the AI SDKs to record metrics from your AI model generation, including duration and tokens.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eFollow these instructions to start using the Python AI SDK in your Python application.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"understand-version-compatibility\" data-state=\"closed\" style=\"cursor:pointer\"\u003eUnderstand version compatibility\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe LaunchDarkly Python AI SDK is compatible with Python 3.8.0 and higher.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"install-the-sdk\" data-state=\"closed\" style=\"cursor:pointer\"\u003eInstall the SDK\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eFirst, install the AI SDK as a dependency in your application using your application’s dependency manager. If you want to depend on a specific version, refer to the \u003ca class=\"fern-mdx-link\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noreferrer\" id=\"customize-a-config\" data-state=\"closed\" style=\"cursor:pointer\"\u003eCustomize a config\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eCustomize your config to set values for variables used in messages or instructions based on the context attributes and variables you provide.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe details of customizing a config depend on whether you are using configs in completion mode or agent mode. You set the mode for a particular config when you \u003ca class=\"fern-mdx-link\" href=\"/docs/home/agentcontrol/create\"\u003ecreate it\u003c/a\u003e in the LaunchDarkly UI.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch4 id=\"customize-configs-in-completion-mode\" data-state=\"closed\" style=\"cursor:pointer\"\u003eCustomize configs in completion mode\u003c/h4\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIn completion mode, each variation in your config includes a single set of roles and messages used to prompt your generative AI model.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIn completion mode, use \u003ccode\u003ecompletion_config()\u003c/code\u003e to customize the config.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe \u003ccode\u003ecompletion_config()\u003c/code\u003e function takes an AgentControl config key, a context, a fallback value, and optional variables. It performs the evaluation, then returns an \u003ccode\u003eAICompletionConfig\u003c/code\u003e object that includes the customized messages and model configuration. Call \u003ccode\u003ecreate_tracker()\u003c/code\u003e on the returned object to get a tracker instance you can use to record metrics.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIf it cannot perform the evaluation or LaunchDarkly is unreachable, the SDK returns the fallback configuration you provided. For example, you might use an empty, disabled \u003ccode\u003eAICompletionConfigDefault\u003c/code\u003e as a fallback value, or a fully configured default. Either way, check for this case and handle it appropriately in your application.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eHere’s how:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"fern-code fern-code-block bg-card-background [\u0026amp;\u0026gt;li]:before:self-center\"\u003e\n\u003cli class=\"\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003ecreate_judge()\u003c/code\u003e retrieves the judge configuration for the provided context\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli class=\"\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003eevaluate()\u003c/code\u003e scores the input and output pair\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli class=\"\"\u003ethe returned result includes structured evaluation data\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIf you want to record returned evaluation scores as metrics associated with a config, track those scores in your application code using the config’s \u003ccode\u003etracker\u003c/code\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eProgrammatic judge evaluation does not automatically emit \u003cstrong class=\"font-semibold\"\u003eMonitoring\u003c/strong\u003e tab metrics. It also does not attach judges to variations in the LaunchDarkly UI.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eTo learn more, read \u003ca class=\"fern-mdx-link\" href=\"/docs/home/agentcontrol/online-evaluations\"\u003eOnline evaluations in AgentControl\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch4 id=\"customize-configs-in-agent-mode\" data-state=\"closed\" style=\"cursor:pointer\"\u003eCustomize configs in agent mode\u003c/h4\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIn agent mode, each variation in your config includes a set of instructions that enable multi-step workflows.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIn \u003ccode\u003eagent\u003c/code\u003e mode, use \u003ccode\u003eagent_config()\u003c/code\u003e or \u003ccode\u003eagent_configs()\u003c/code\u003e to customize the config. The \u003ccode\u003eagent_config()\u003c/code\u003e function customizes a single agent config, while the \u003ccode\u003eagent_configs()\u003c/code\u003e function customizes a list of them.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe instructions returned by the SDK come directly from the instructions you define for the variation in the LaunchDarkly UI. The goal or task shown in the UI is delivered unchanged as the \u003ccode\u003einstructions\u003c/code\u003e field in the SDK.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eBoth functions take an AgentControl config key, a context, a fallback value, and optional variables. They perform the evaluation, then return an \u003ccode\u003eAIAgentConfig\u003c/code\u003e object that includes the customized instructions. Call \u003ccode\u003ecreate_tracker()\u003c/code\u003e on the returned object to get a tracker instance for recording metrics.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIf the function cannot perform the evaluation or LaunchDarkly is unreachable, it returns the fallback value.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eFor example, you might use an empty, disabled \u003ccode\u003eAIAgentConfigDefault\u003c/code\u003e as a fallback value, or a fully configured default. Either way, you should make sure to check for this case and handle it appropriately in your application.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eHere’s how:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"fern-code learn more, read \u003ca class=\"fern-mdx-link\" href=\"/docs/sdk/features/agentcontrol-config#python-ai\"\u003eCustomizing AgentControl configs\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003ch3 id=\"call-the-provider-and-record-metrics-from-ai-model-generation\" data-state=\"closed\" style=\"cursor:pointer\"\u003eCall the provider and record metrics from AI model generation\u003c/h3\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eFinally, make a request to your generative AI provider and record metrics from your AI model generation.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIn completion mode, use the tracker’s \u003ccode\u003etrack_metrics_of()\u003c/code\u003e method to call your generative AI provider and record metrics from model generation. Pass a metrics extractor function (such as \u003ccode\u003eget_ai_metrics_from_response\u003c/code\u003e from the provider-specific package) and the call you want to make. Check whether the returned \u003ccode\u003econfig\u003c/code\u003e is enabled and handle the disabled case appropriately in your application.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eIf your AgentControl config uses \u003ccode\u003eagent\u003c/code\u003e mode, you can access the \u003ccode\u003einstructions\u003c/code\u003e returned from the customized AgentControl config to send to your AI model. Call \u003ccode\u003ecreate_tracker()\u003c/code\u003e on the returned \u003ccode\u003eAIAgentConfig\u003c/code\u003e object to get a tracker instance you can use to record metrics.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eTracking AI metrics does not automatically associate traces with the config.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv data-intent=\"important\" class=\"fern-callout\"\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"flex items-start space-x-4\"\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"[\u0026amp;_svg]:size-icon-md mt-0.5 w-4\"\u003e\u003csvg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"24\" height=\"24\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" stroke-width=\"2\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" class=\"lucide lucide-info\"\u003e\u003ccircle cx=\"12\" cy=\"12\" r=\"10\"\u003e\u003c/circle\u003e\u003cpath d=\"M12 16v-4\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003cpath d=\"M12 8h.01\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003cdiv class=\"-my-4 flex-1 overflow-x-auto text-sm before:mb-4 before:block after:mt-4 after:block\"\u003e\u003ch5 class=\"leading-snug\"\u003eRun model calls inside an active span to associate traces\u003c/h5\u003e\u003cp\u003eLaunchDarkly can associate traces with an evaluated config only when the model request runs inside an active parent span.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eIf you use the LaunchDarkly Observability SDK, import \u003ccode\u003eobserve\u003c/code\u003e from \u003ccode\u003eldobserve\u003c/code\u003e and wrap each model request in \u003ccode\u003eobserve.start_span()\u003c/code\u003e. This creates the parent span LaunchDarkly uses to link the LLM span to the evaluated config. LaunchDarkly cannot associate the trace with the config if the model call does not run inside an active span.\u003c/p\u003e\u003cp\u003eTo learn more, read \u003ca class=\"fern-mdx-link\" href=\"/docs/home/observability/llm-observability\"\u003eLLM observability\u003c/a\u003e and \u003ca class=\"fern-mdx-link\" href=\"/docs/home/agentcontrol/monitor\"\u003eMonitor configs\u003c/a\u003e.\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eThe following example shows how to wrap an OpenAI completion request in an active span so LaunchDarkly can associate traces with the evaluated config.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"fern-code fern-code-block bg-card-background border-card-border rounded-3 shadow-card-grayscale relative mt-12 w-fit\",\"lang\":\"en\"}],\"$L149\"]}]\n14a:T40c7,"])</script><script>self.__next_f.push([1,"---\nslug: /sdk/ai/python\ntitle: Python AI SDK reference\ndescription: \u003e-\n  This topic documents how to get started with the Python AI SDK, and links to\n  reference information on all of the supported features.\nkeywords: python, sdk, ai\n---\n\nThis topic documents how to get started with the Python AI SDK, and links to reference information on all of the supported features.\n\nThe Python AI SDK is designed for use with AgentControl. It is currently in a pre-1.0 release and under active development. You can follow development or contribute on [GitHub](https://github.com/launchdarkly/python-server-sdk-ai).\n\n\u003cCallout intent=\"note\" title='SDK quick links'\u003e\n\nLaunchDarkly's SDKs are open source. In addition to this reference guide, we provide source, API reference documentation, and sample applications:\n\n\u003ctable class=\"fern-table\"\u003e\n  \u003ctr\u003e\n    \u003cth\u003eResource\u003c/th\u003e\n    \u003cth\u003eLocation\u003c/th\u003e\n  \u003c/tr\u003e\n\n    \u003ctr\u003e\n      \u003ctd\u003eSDK API documentation\u003c/td\u003e\n      \u003ctd\u003e[SDK API docs](https://launchdarkly-python-sdk-ai.readthedocs.io)\u003c/td\u003e\n    \u003c/tr\u003e\n    \u003ctr\u003e\n      \u003ctd\u003eGitHub repository\u003c/td\u003e\n      \u003ctd\u003e[python-server-sdk-ai](https://github.com/launchdarkly/python-server-sdk-ai)\u003c/td\u003e\n    \u003c/tr\u003e\n    \u003ctr\u003e\n      \u003ctd\u003eSample application\u003c/td\u003e\n      \u003ctd\u003e[Using Bedrock](https://github.com/launchdarkly/hello-python-ai/tree/main/getting_started/bedrock/converse), [Using OpenAI](https://github.com/launchdarkly/hello-python-ai/tree/main/getting_started/openai/chat_completions), [Using Gemini](https://github.com/launchdarkly/hello-python-ai/tree/main/getting_started/gemini/generate_content), [Using LangChain](https://github.com/launchdarkly/hello-python-ai/tree/main/getting_started/langchain/invoke)\u003c/td\u003e\n    \u003c/tr\u003e\n    \u003ctr\u003e\n      \u003ctd\u003ePublished module\u003c/td\u003e\n      \u003ctd\u003e[PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/launchdarkly-server-sdk-ai/)\u003c/td\u003e\n    \u003c/tr\u003e\n\n\u003c/table\u003e\n\n\u003c/Callout\u003e\n\n## Get started\n\nLaunchDarkly AI SDKs interact with [AgentControl configs](/home/getting-started/vocabulary#agentcontrol-config). Configs are the LaunchDarkly resources that manage model configurations and messages for your generative AI applications.\n\n\u003cCallout intent=\"tip\" title='Try the Quickstart'\u003e\n\nThis reference guide describes working specifically with the Python AI SDK. For a complete introduction to LaunchDarkly AI SDKs and how they interact with configs, read [Quickstart for AgentControl](/home/agentcontrol/quickstart).\n\n\u003c/Callout\u003e\n\nYou can use the Python AI SDK to customize your config based on the [context](/home/getting-started/vocabulary#context) that you provide. This means both the messages and the model evaluation in your generative AI application are specific to each end user, at runtime. You can also use the AI SDKs to record metrics from your AI model generation, including duration and tokens.\n\nFollow these instructions to start using the Python AI SDK in your Python application.\n\n### Understand version compatibility\n\nThe LaunchDarkly Python AI SDK is compatible with Python 3.8.0 and higher.\n\n### Install the SDK\n\nFirst, install the AI SDK as a dependency in your application using your application's dependency manager. If you want to depend on a specific version, refer to the [SDK releases page](https://github.com/launchdarkly/python-server-sdk-ai/releases) to identify the latest version.\n\nHere's how:\n\n\u003cCodeBlocks\u003e\n\u003cCodeBlock title='Shell'\u003e\n\n```bash\npip install launchdarkly-server-sdk\npip install launchdarkly-server-sdk-ai\n```\n\n\u003c/CodeBlock\u003e\n\u003c/CodeBlocks\u003e\n\nNext, import the LaunchDarkly `LDAIClient` into your application code:\n\n\u003cCodeBlocks\u003e\n\u003cCodeBlock title='Python'\u003e\n\n```python\n\nfrom ldclient import Context\nfrom ldclient.config import Config\nfrom ldai import LDAIClient, AICompletionConfigDefault, ModelConfig, LDMessage, ProviderConfig\n```\n\n\u003c/CodeBlock\u003e\n\u003c/CodeBlocks\u003e\n\n### Initialize the client\n\nAfter you install and import the AI SDK, create a single, shared instance of `LDAIClient`. Specify your SDK key here to authorize your application to connect to a particular environment within LaunchDarkly.\n\n\u003cCallout intent=\"note\" title='The Python AI SDK uses an SDK key'\u003e\n\nThe Python AI SDK uses an SDK key. Keys are specific to each project and environment. They are available on the **SDK keys** page under **Settings**. To learn more about key types, read [Keys](/sdk/concepts/client-side-server-side#keys-and-credentials).\n\n\u003c/Callout\u003e\n\nHere's how:\n\n\u003cCodeBlocks\u003e\n\u003cCodeBlock title='Python'\u003e\n\n```python\nldclient.set_config(Config(\"YOUR_SDK_KEY\"))\naiclient = LDAIClient(ldclient.get())\n```\n\n\u003c/CodeBlock\u003e\n\u003c/CodeBlocks\u003e\n\n### Configure the context\n\nConfigure the context that will encounter generated AI content in your application. Context attributes determine which variation of the config LaunchDarkly serves, based on the targeting rules in your config. If you use template variables in config variation messages, context attributes also provide values for those variables.\n\nHere's how:\n\n\u003cCodeBlocks\u003e\n\u003cCodeBlock title='Python AI SDK'\u003e\n\n```python\ncontext = Context.builder(\"example-context-key\") \\\n    .set(\"firstName\", \"Sandy\") \\\n    .set(\"lastName\", \"Smith\") \\\n    .set(\"email\", \"sandy@example.com\") \\\n    .set(\"groups\", [\"Acme\", \"Global Health Services\"]) \\\n    .build()\n```\n\n\u003c/CodeBlock\u003e\n\u003c/CodeBlocks\u003e\n\n### Customize a config\n\nCustomize your config to set values for variables used in messages or instructions based on the context attributes and variables you provide.\n\nThe details of customizing a config depend on whether you are using configs in completion mode or agent mode. You set the mode for a particular config when you [create it](/home/agentcontrol/create) in the LaunchDarkly UI.\n\n#### Customize configs in completion mode\n\nIn completion mode, each variation in your config includes a single set of roles and messages used to prompt your generative AI model.\n\nIn completion mode, use `completion_config()` to customize the config.\n\nThe `completion_config()` function takes an AgentControl config key, a context, a fallback value, and optional variables. It performs the evaluation, then returns an `AICompletionConfig` object that includes the customized messages and model configuration. Call `create_tracker()` on the returned object to get a tracker instance you can use to record metrics.\n\nIf it cannot perform the evaluation or LaunchDarkly is unreachable, the SDK returns the fallback configuration you provided. For example, you might use an empty, disabled `AICompletionConfigDefault` as a fallback value, or a fully configured default. Either way, check for this case and handle it appropriately in your application.\n\nHere's how:\n\n\u003cCodeBlocks\u003e\n\u003cCodeBlock title='Customize a config in completion mode'\u003e\n\n```python\nfallback_value = AICompletionConfigDefault(enabled=False)\n\nconfig = aiclient.completion_config(\n    'example-config-key',\n    context,\n    fallback_value,\n    { 'example_custom_variable': 'example_custom_value' }\n)\n\ntracker = config.create_tracker()\n```\n\n\u003c/CodeBlock\u003e\n\u003c/CodeBlocks\u003e\n\n### Evaluate input and output pairs with a judge\n\nUse `create_judge()` when you need to score a specific input and output pair in application code. This is useful for external pipelines, custom orchestration, or any case where you want to evaluate output directly instead of attaching a judge to a completion-mode config variation.\n\n`create_judge()` retrieves the judge configuration for the provided context. Then, call `evaluate()` on the returned judge to score the input and output pair.\n\nHere's how:\n\n\u003cCodeBlocks\u003e\n\u003cCodeBlock title=\"Evaluate input and output directly with a judge\"\u003e\n\n```python\nfrom ldai import AIJudgeConfigDefault\n\nfallback = AIJudgeConfigDefault(enabled=False)\n\njudge = aiclient.create_judge(\n    \"your-judge-key\",\n    context,\n    fallback,\n)\n\nif judge:\n    result = await judge.evaluate(input_text, output_text)\n\n    if result.sampled and result.success:\n        print(result.score, result.reasoning)\n```\n\n\u003c/CodeBlock\u003e\n\u003c/CodeBlocks\u003e\n\nIn this example:\n\n- `create_judge()` retrieves the judge configuration for the provided context\n- `evaluate()` scores the input and output pair\n- the returned result includes structured evaluation data\n\nIf you want to record returned evaluation scores as metrics associated with a config, track those scores in your application code using the config's `tracker`.\n\nProgrammatic judge evaluation does not automatically emit **Monitoring** tab metrics. It also does not attach judges to variations in the LaunchDarkly UI.\n\nTo learn more, read [Online evaluations in AgentControl](/home/agentcontrol/online-evaluations).\n\n#### Customize configs in agent mode\n\nIn agent mode, each variation in your config includes a set of instructions that enable multi-step workflows.\n\nIn `agent` mode, use `agent_config()` or `agent_configs()` to customize the config. The `agent_config()` function customizes a single agent config, while the `agent_configs()` function customizes a list of them.\n\nThe instructions returned by the SDK come directly from the instructions you define for the variation in the LaunchDarkly UI. The goal or task shown in the UI is delivered unchanged as the `instructions` field in the SDK.\n\nBoth functions take an AgentControl config key, a context, a fallback value, and optional variables. They perform the evaluation, then return an `AIAgentConfig` object that includes the customized instructions. Call `create_tracker()` on the returned object to get a tracker instance for recording metrics.\n\nIf the function cannot perform the evaluation or LaunchDarkly is unreachable, it returns the fallback value.\n\nFor example, you might use an empty, disabled `AIAgentConfigDefault` as a fallback value, or a fully configured default. Either way, you should make sure to check for this case and handle it appropriately in your application.\n\nHere's how:\n\n\u003cCodeBlocks\u003e\n\u003cCodeBlock title='Customize a config in agent mode'\u003e\n\n```python\nfrom ldai import AIAgentConfigDefault\n\nagent = aiclient.agent_config(\n  'example-config-key',\n  context,\n  AIAgentConfigDefault(\n    enabled=False\n  ),\n  { 'example_custom_variable': 'example_custom_value'}\n)\n```\n\n\u003c/CodeBlock\u003e\n\u003c/CodeBlocks\u003e\n\nTo learn more, read [Customizing AgentControl configs](/sdk/features/agentcontrol-config#python-ai).\n\n### Call the provider and record metrics from AI model generation\n\nFinally, make a request to your generative AI provider and record metrics from your AI model generation.\n\nIn completion mode, use the tracker's `track_metrics_of()` method to call your generative AI provider and record metrics from model generation. Pass a metrics extractor function (such as `get_ai_metrics_from_response` from the provider-specific package) and the call you want to make. Check whether the returned `config` is enabled and handle the disabled case appropriately in your application.\n\nIf your AgentControl config uses `agent` mode, you can access the `instructions` returned from the customized AgentControl config to send to your AI model. Call `create_tracker()` on the returned `AIAgentConfig` object to get a tracker instance you can use to record metrics.\n\nTracking AI metrics does not automatically associate traces with the config.\n\n\u003cCallout intent=\"important\" title=\"Run model calls inside an active span to associate traces\"\u003e\n\nLaunchDarkly can associate traces with an evaluated config only when the model request runs inside an active parent span.\n\nIf you use the LaunchDarkly Observability SDK, import `observe` from `ldobserve` and wrap each model request in `observe.start_span()`. This creates the parent span LaunchDarkly uses to link the LLM span to the evaluated config. LaunchDarkly cannot associate the trace with the config if the model call does not run inside an active span.\n\nTo learn more, read [LLM observability](/home/observability/llm-observability) and [Monitor configs](/home/agentcontrol/monitor).\n\n\u003c/Callout\u003e\n\nThe following example shows how to wrap an OpenAI completion request in an active span so LaunchDarkly can associate traces with the evaluated config.\n\n\u003cCodeBlocks\u003e\n\u003cCodeBlock title=\"Using OpenAI model with trace association, completion mode\"\u003e\n\n```python\nfrom ldobserve import observe\nfrom ldai_openai import get_ai_metrics_from_response\n\nif config.enabled:\n    messages = [] if config.messages is None else config.messages\n\n    # Wrap the provider call in a span so LaunchDarkly can associate traces\n    # with the evaluated config.\n    with observe.start_span(\"llm.chat\"):\n        completion = tracker.track_metrics_of(\n            get_ai_metrics_from_response,\n            lambda: openai_client.chat.completions.create(\n                model=config.model.name,\n                messages=[message.to_dict() for message in messages],\n            ),\n        )\nelse:\n    # Application path to take when the config is disabled\n```\n\n\u003c/CodeBlock\u003e\n\u003c/CodeBlocks\u003e\n\nIf you are not using observability, or if you have already ensured the model call runs inside an active span, you can call your provider and record AI metrics as shown below.\n\n\u003cCodeBlocks\u003e\n\u003cCodeBlock title='Using OpenAI model, completion mode'\u003e\n\n```python\nfrom ldai_openai import get_ai_metrics_from_response\n\nif config.enabled:\n    # Pass in a metrics extractor and a callable that invokes your OpenAI client.\n    # When calling the OpenAI operation, use details from config.\n    # For instance, you can pass config.model.name\n    # and config.messages[0].content to your specific OpenAI operation.\n    #\n    # CAUTION: If the call inside of track_metrics_of throws an exception,\n    # the SDK will re-throw that exception\n\n    messages = [] if config.messages is None else config.messages\n    completion = tracker.track_metrics_of(\n        get_ai_metrics_from_response,\n        lambda: openai_client.chat.completions.create(\n            model=config.model.name,\n            messages=[message.to_dict() for message in messages],\n        ),\n    )\nelse:\n    # Application path to take when the config is disabled\n```\n\n\u003c/CodeBlock\u003e\n\u003cCodeBlock title='Using Bedrock model, completion mode'\u003e\n\n```python\nif config.enabled:\n    # Pass in the result of the Bedrock Converse command.\n    # When calling the Bedrock Converse command, use details from config.\n    # For instance, you can pass config.model.name\n    # and config.messages[0].content to your specific Bedrock Converse command.\n\n    completion = tracker.track_bedrock_converse_metrics(\n        client.converse(\n            modelId=config.model.name,\n            messages=map_messages_to_conversation(config.messages)\n        )\n    )\nelse:\n    # Application path to take when the config is disabled\n```\n\n\u003c/CodeBlock\u003e\n\u003cCodeBlock title=\"Accessing instructions and recording metrics, agent mode\"\u003e\n\n```python\nif agent.enabled:\n    tracker = agent.create_tracker()\n\n    # Retrieve instructions from the AgentControl config and pass to your AI model\n    result = example_model_api(agent.instructions)\n\n    # Track metrics from the result\n    tracker.track_success()\nelse:\n    # Application path to take when the agent is disabled\n```\n\n\u003c/CodeBlock\u003e\n\u003c/CodeBlocks\u003e\n\nAlternatively, you can use the SDK's other `track_*` functions to record these metrics manually. You may need to do this if your application requires streaming, since `track_metrics_of()` expects the wrapped call to return a complete response.\n\nIn `completion` mode, make sure to call `completion_config()` each time you generate content from your AI model:\n\n\u003cCodeBlocks\u003e\n\u003cCodeBlock title='Using OpenAI model, next request to provider'\u003e\n\n```python\nfrom ldai_openai import get_ai_metrics_from_response\n\nconfig = aiclient.completion_config(\n    'example-config-key',\n    context,\n    fallback_value,\n    { 'example_custom_variable': 'example_custom_value' }\n)\ntracker = config.create_tracker()\n\ncompletion = tracker.track_metrics_of(get_ai_metrics_from_response, lambda: ...)\n```\n\n\u003c/CodeBlock\u003e\n\u003cCodeBlock title='Using Bedrock model, next request to provider'\u003e\n\n```python\nconfig = aiclient.completion_config(\n    'example-config-key',\n    context,\n    fallback_value,\n    { 'example_custom_variable': 'example_custom_value' }\n)\ntracker = config.create_tracker()\n\ncompletion = tracker.track_bedrock_converse_metrics(client.converse(...))\n```\n\n\u003c/CodeBlock\u003e\n\u003c/CodeBlocks\u003e\n\nTo learn more, read [Tracking AI metrics](/sdk/features/ai-metrics#python-ai).\n\n## Supported features\n\nThis SDK supports the following features:\n\n* [Anonymous contexts](/sdk/features/anonymous#python-ai)\n* [Context configuration](/sdk/features/context-config#python-ai)\n* [Customizing AgentControl configs](/sdk/features/agentcontrol-config#python-ai)\n* [Private attributes](/sdk/features/private-attributes#python-ai)\n* [Tracking AI metrics](/sdk/features/ai-metrics#python-ai)"])</script><script>self.__next_f.push([1,"134:{\"content\":\"$14a\",\"contentType\":\"mdx\"}\n132:\"Python AI SDK
